### [`fall_attack_refill_timer`](../../../../src/actor/actor_workspace.asm#L8) `$4EEC`

*variable*

Actor workspace. init_game_variables clears $4EED-$4FE7 (contact_col0 .. burst_trap_row) at a game start. fall_attack_refill_timer: frame_update counts it down every frame; at 0 the three fall_attack_budget bytes are set to 2.

- **Read by:** [`frame_update`](../game/frame_update.md#frame_update) [`$15BD`](../../../../src/game/frame_update.asm#L31), [`frame_update`](../game/frame_update.md#frame_update) [`$15CD`](../../../../src/game/frame_update.asm#L38)
- **Written by:** [`frame_update`](../game/frame_update.md#frame_update) [`$15CD`](../../../../src/game/frame_update.asm#L38)
